hero.eyebrow: Houston CPA firm for service businesses
hero.title: Let's take care of the financial stuff so you can get back to what you do best – running your business.
hero.lead: George CPA Firm handles the bookkeeping, tax, payroll and CFO work for service-based businesses in Houston, so you keep more of what you earn and worry less about your business's financial future.

overview.title: Comprehensive financial support to empower you.
overview.text: We assess where you stand financially, then craft and implement solutions that fit. Pick a service to see what it covers, or call and talk it through with our team.

services.title: Bookkeeping
services.text: Our bookkeeping goes beyond data entry. We maintain accurate records, deliver real-time insights and support informed decisions to keep your cash flow strong.
services.lead: Struggling to open QuickBooks and make sense of it all? Overwhelmed with the changing interface and all the to-dos to get your financial statements correct? Our bookkeeping services go beyond data entry.

covers.title: Transactions and reconciliations
covers.text: We meticulously record your transactions and reconcile accounts, including daily bank and credit card reconciliation at our Premier level.

covers.title: Clear financial statements
covers.text: Monthly financial statements that give you a precise understanding of your business's financial health.

covers.title: Systems that scale
covers.text: Streamlined systems and processes that scale with your operations, so your reporting is robust enough to support strategic planning or secure funding.

covers.title: Cleanup and historical data
covers.text: Transforming messy QuickBooks into organized, accurate records, including wrangling historical data into streamlined reporting.

questions.q: What software do you work in?
questions.a: We work in QuickBooks Online and Xero, and we provide QuickBooks support as part of every package.

questions.q: Can I use the financials with my banker?
questions.a: Yes. Whether you need accurate financials to give to your banker, file your tax return or make a decision, we will support you to get the correct end result.

services.title: Tax
services.summary: Business tax filing, planning and strategy.
services.text: Our team optimizes your financial records and tax strategies to maximize earnings and reduce your tax burden, with accurate, proactive work that supports effective planning.
services.lead: Navigating tax filing is complex. We go beyond basic compliance, developing tax strategies designed for growing service companies and identifying opportunities to maximize deductions and minimize liabilities.

covers.title: Business tax preparation
covers.text: Business and personal tax returns prepared on meticulous financial records, so filing is straightforward.

covers.title: Proactive planning
covers.text: Quarterly tax projections and planning for the tax implications of new hires, expanded services or geographical diversification.

covers.title: Deductions and credits
covers.text: We work to identify eligible deductions and credits so you keep more of what you earn.

covers.title: Filings and forms
covers.text: 1099 preparation and filing, payroll tax reconciliation, and sales tax filings available on request.

questions.q: Do you handle both the business and the owner's return?
questions.a: Yes. Business and personal tax preparation are both included in our packages, because an owner's personal return is usually intertwined with the company's financials.

questions.q: Can you represent me before the IRS?
questions.a: IRS representation is available as an additional service on request.

services.title: Payroll Services

services.lead: Your team is central to your growth, and keeping them paid accurately and on time is non-negotiable. We take the burden of payroll off your shoulders.

covers.title: Pay cycles and deposits

covers.title: Payroll tax filings

questions.a: Payroll processing is available as an additional service on request, and payroll tax reconciliation is included from our Essential level up.

about.title: From overwhelm to clarity: our journey.
text: George CPA Firm, LLC was founded in 2017 with a deep understanding of the challenges business owners face. We know the feeling of being tired, stressed and overwhelmed by finances, or the spiral that comes with trying to organize everything in QuickBooks while running your business and still having time for yourself.

That's why we built a firm specifically to be your partner. We saw a need for approachable, knowledgeable experts who could truly support businesses beyond just basic record-keeping, so you can keep more of what you earn and worry less about your business's health and financial future.

Our mission is clear: we assess our clients' current financial state, then craft and implement innovative solutions. We envision a future where every business owner feels confident and in control of their financial health, free from stress and uncertainty.

team.name: Rae Ann George, CPA
team.bio: Rae Ann George, the business owner's CPA, established George CPA Firm, LLC to help business owners succeed financially. Beyond crunching numbers and formulating tax strategies to save clients money, she is dedicated to making financial record-keeping and financial statement preparation a seamless part of business owners' processes, then using the data from those statements to help owners manage and grow. As a member of the American Institute of CPAs, she has access to the latest industry standards and best practices, which she applies for the benefit of her clients. A strong proponent of our core value of Always Learning, Rae Ann has participated in the Goldman Sachs 10K Small Business Program, the Houston Urban League Small Business Program and other business accelerator programs across Houston. She has sat on various boards and committees, including NAWBO-Houston, EEDC and Toastmasters International District 56. When not serving clients, Rae Ann enjoys growing giant cucumbers, gardening and traveling for food tours.

team.name: Nikesha Ramnarace Rampersad, MBA
team.bio: Nikesha is a seasoned accounting and finance professional with over a decade of experience and a solid academic foundation. Her portfolio as Accounting Manager includes comprehensive financial statement preparation, expert bookkeeping, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management. She is known for her commitment to continuous improvement and her disciplined focus on accuracy, efficiency, timeliness and auditability. When not designing and implementing financial recording workflows, Nikesha loves to read, is a foodie always on the hunt for new flavors and an unbeatable Monopoly champion.

team.name: Kenwyn Peters, MBA
team.bio: Kenwyn is a versatile business consultant with experience across telecommunications, medical laboratories, financial services, iron and steel, furniture, food services and construction. He brings multidisciplinary experience in sales and marketing, project management, human resources, strategic planning, entrepreneurship, supply chain management and customer experience to clients as they strategize and grow. His background includes an MBA specializing in entrepreneurial management and multiple certificates in project management, leadership, operations and supply chain management. When not engaged in strategy sessions, Kenwyn enjoys going to the beach and searching for that perfect mango.

team.name: Marie Francis, BBA
team.role: Senior Administrator, Marketing & Customer Service Specialist
team.bio: Marie is a highly trained senior administrator, marketer and customer service specialist. She brings leadership in quality assurance, process improvement and re-engineering initiatives, project planning, customer experience design, event planning and social media marketing. Her passion for people and dedication to achieving win-win results are key attributes that ensure her success. When taking a break from design and content creation, Marie enjoys spending time with family and friends, serving at church and writing poetry.

team.name: Rachel Docdocil, BSc
team.bio: Rachel is a senior bookkeeper with a specialization in tax. Known for providing accurate and timely financial statements, she is highly proficient in preparing and analyzing daily financial transactions, complex accounting problems, untangling payroll issues and all other facets of bookkeeping. She prides herself on her critical thinking skills and her attention to detail. She exhibits the highest levels of integrity and confidentiality in the execution of her duties. When not crunching numbers, Rachel enjoys all things pink, traveling with her family and growing roses.

team.name: Sherry-Ann Bailey-Seethal, BA
team.bio: Sherry-Ann specializes in transforming messy QuickBooks into organized and accurate financial records. With a special focus on wrangling historical data into streamlined reporting, her attention to detail and focus on complete record-keeping and establishing systems for good record-keeping contribute to the accuracy and efficiency of client deliverables. Outside of work, Sherry-Ann enjoys sports, hiking and making beautiful memories with her family.

team.name: Nia Williams, BSc
team.bio: Nia helps business owners answer the question "How do I know if I made a profit?" and keeps their financial statements accurate month after month. She is known for her reliability and consistency in daily financial tasks, and supports the bookkeeping team with diligence and professionalism while continuing to expand her technical skills in accounting. When not crunching numbers, Nia is a foodie who enjoys cooking, gaming and planning her travel adventures.

faqs.a: Growth-focused service businesses with revenues typically between $1 million and $10 million, newer startups and solo entrepreneurs who need reliable bookkeeping and tax work, and individuals who need personal tax preparation and financial advisory.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to work with a CPA?
faqs.a: Pricing doesn't need to be a mystery. Our Essential level runs $500 to $1,250 a month, Accelerate $950 to $2,750 a month and Premier $2,500 to $12,500 a month, and we can customize a price for you. Your exact, flat monthly fee is confirmed in a free, no-pressure consultation.

faqs.q: What is included at the Essential level?
faqs.a: Monthly bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, payroll tax reconciliation, monthly financial statements, 1099 preparation and filing, QuickBooks support, and business and personal tax preparation.
Everything in Essential, expanded to include quarterly business advisory, quarterly tax projections, goal setting and budget preparation, and budget to actual variance analysis.

Everything in Accelerate, plus monthly business and tax advisory, daily bank and credit card account reconciliation, a reasonable salary compensation study and a Value Builder growth-focused engagement.

faqs.q: Can I see what my books are costing before I call?
faqs.a: Yes. Our price estimator asks a few quick questions about your entity type, revenue, services and headcount and gives you a ballpark range to help you plan. It is not a quote; we set a flat, predictable monthly fee once we understand your situation.

Her experience working with other attorneys was evident in the thoughtful, strategic questions she asked to understand where I was coming from. I left the conversation feeling supported, understood, and better positioned to make smart financial decisions.
